scientific_integrity: The proof is exact and analytic. The bundled numerical script is only a regression check of the density-ratio identity, sign change, monotonicity, and numerical one-standard-deviation threshold; it is not used as evidence for the infinite-parameter theorem. Originality is supported by source-level comparison and targeted searches, with an explicit residual risk for older applied lognormal literature under different terminology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the one-dimensional lognormal family and symmetric density comparison about the arithmetic mean on the common reflected support. It does not determine a global anti-concentration optimum, a stochastic order, or an extremum over broader distribution classes.
title: Exact reflected-density crossing for standardized lognormal laws
